description: NFC boundary — INFORMATIVE contrast: an NFC-normalising construction applied to the same input as jcs-n-kat-12 produces a DIFFERENT digest. jcs-n is NOT NFC-normalising; this fixture documents what a buggy or intentionally-normalising profile would compute, so implementations can detect the deviation. Marked must_fail to exclude from the jcs-n pass suite.
note: NFC(U+0041 U+030A) = U+00C5 ('Å', LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A WITH RING ABOVE). A normalising construction that applies NFC before or after member-sort encodes the key as the 2-byte UTF-8 sequence 0xC3 0x85, while jcs-n preserves the 3-byte decomposed sequence 0x41 0xCC 0x8A. Both members sort identically (B len-1 before the ring-key len-2 in decomposed form; B before Å len-1 in NFC form, same order different bytes). A profile that normalises MUST declare its normalisation form and order (NFC-before-sort vs sort-before-NFC); failing to declare produces a digest context that cannot be deterministically reproduced. jcs-n makes no such normalisation; nfc_contrast_digest is evidence of deviation, not a valid jcs-n result.
